name: Naive Isosurface Extraction
definition: An isosurface extraction algorithm that processes each tetrahedron independently to generate a collection of individual, unconnected polygons.
summary: Naive Isosurface Extraction is an algorithm that processes each tetrahedron independently to generate unconnected polygons, differing from standard Marching Tetrahedra by iterating through edges to find intersections rather than using a lookup table.
